dedupe_keys.name: wwscan pathogen nucleic acids in 147 us wastewater plants 2024 2025

description: WastewaterSCAN researchers measured human-pathogen nucleic acids in wastewater solids from 147 treatment plants across forty United States states. The Data in Brief article gives dates from 1 July 2024 through 15 September 2025, with samples collected up to seven times a week and measured using droplet digital PCR methods. It names the CSV WWSCAN_AllPlants_SDR_2025.csv. The Stanford Digital Repository page and DataCite state CC BY-NC 4.0; an unauthenticated HEAD request to the article-named CSV returned HTTP 200 and text/csv without fetching rows. Coverage is participating plants and pathogen signals, not a census of every sewer network or direct plant treatment-efficiency measurements. Plant participation, sampling frequency, laboratory methods and interpretation of nucleic-acid levels are limitations for comparing locations or estimating clinical incidence. A reviewer-assessed use is testing wastewater surveillance signals in emergency-response or sewer digital-twin scenarios. data-wastewaterscan describes the wider programme and a different 191-plant deposit; this specific 2024–2025 CSV has its own DOI. data-cdc-nwss-wastewater-surveillance is a related national aggregation. No CSV rows were downloaded or analysed.
